correctness.rationale: PASS: On a fixed labelled permutation the Boolean subalgebra generated by k ordered subsets and all forward/backward permutation translates is precisely the fiber algebra of the bi-infinite q-color itineraries, q=2^k. Distinct itineraries are equivalent to primitive length-n words on each n-cycle and distinct primitive rotation classes between equal-length cycles. Möbius inversion gives N_n(q)=n^{-1}sum_{d|n}mu(d)q^{n/d}; independent labelled cycles give product n^{m_n}(N_n(q))_{falling m_n}, also valid for n=1 and k=0. When m/q^{n/2}->t and n fixed, internal nonprimitive count is binomial with mean -> 1_{2|n}t because the maximal proper period is n/2 iff n even; collision factorial moments give Pois(nt²/2); conditioning on tight U yields independent coordinates. Disjoint-pair dominance holds as overlapping connected v-vertex collision components cost O(N^{1-v/2}) for v>=3. The zero/t->0 regime and outer thresholds follow first moments and birthday bounds. I independently counted primitive q=3 necklaces N_1=3,N_2=3,N_3=8,N_4=18 and verified finite tuple counts for multiplicities 1..3 by explicit cyclic orbit enumeration, not by trusting checker output. Finite enumeration corroborates the formula, not its asymptotic proof.
